reading.zh: 两份 Json 结构都是 {"datas":[...]}：TestTable 验证多类型列，LoadingTable 验证 bool 裸小写与浮点列。它们是导出产物，不要手改。
reading.en: Both files share the {"datas":[...]} shape: TestTable exercises mixed column types, LoadingTable exercises a bare-lowercase bool and float columns. They are generated - do not hand-edit.
